pages.title: Adopting Paco
pages.text: Paco is a loyal canine companion adopting from village kennels for $(a)1 Emerald$(0).$(br2)Paco can be field-retrofitted with standard workbench upgrades into progressively lethal tactical configurations.

pages.title: Tactical Field Upgrades
pages.text: Upgrade tiers via crafting:$(br)$(bullet) $(6)Concussive Paco:$(0) Paco + Piston (kinetic blast bark)$(br)$(bullet) $(b)Attack Paco:$(0) Concussive + Diamond (armor-shredding bite)$(br)$(bullet) $(d)Assault Paco:$(0) Attack + Nether Star (rapid-fire barrage)$(br)$(bullet) $(a)Sniper Paco:$(0) Assault + Spyglass (extreme range targeting)

pages.title: Hellhound Paco
pages.text: Transmute in the Cube:$(br)$(bullet) Paco$(br)$(bullet) Blaze Powder$(br)$(bullet) Dragon's Breath$(br2)Unleashes a demonic nether hound emitting searing incendiary flame bursts that ignite whole mobs.

pages.title: J. Paco Barkkenheimer
pages.text: Transmute in the Cube:$(br)$(bullet) Paco$(br)$(bullet) Oppenheimer's Hat$(br2)$(o)"Now I am become Bark, the destroyer of mailmen."$(reset)$(br2)High-yield classified post-game canine ordinance. Unlocking this final form awards the $(6)Paco Painting$(0)!
